decisions.reason: The preceding client message explicitly includes both iOS and Android FAQ content, but the Android Requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing FAQ localization through app strings.
Representing FAQ content as localizable app strings does not change the current iOS download-size optimization requirements.
The source concerns FAQ localization, not the independently defined delivery format or URL for How-To-Use content.
Localizing FAQ content through app strings does not necessarily change the Android package-size optimization requirement or its current attributes.
